# llms.txt for www.stradivarius.com
# Global declaration for language models regarding the content, structure and purpose of Stradivarius' website.

website_name: Stradivarius  
website_url: https://www.stradivarius.com  
default_language: en  
available_languages: es, en, fr, it, pt, tr, pl, el, ro, de, nl, il, hr, rs, co, mx, us, gb, ar, hu, bg, cz, sk, ua, ma, tn, etc.  
target_audience: young women (16–35) interested in fashion, trends, and lifestyle  
main_markets: ES, TR, FR, IT, PL, GR, PT, MX, RS, DE, GB, RO, CO, IL, NL, US

brand_description:  
Stradivarius is a global fashion brand for young women and part of the Inditex Group. The website showcases weekly collections of clothing, footwear, and accessories, reflecting the latest trends. It provides an inspirational, intuitive, and aesthetically driven online shopping experience.

core_purpose:  
To offer young women worldwide fashionable, accessible and expressive clothing through a seamless and visually inspiring e-commerce platform.

main_sections:  
- /new-in/ – New arrivals  
- /women/clothing/ – Women's clothing  
- /women/shoes/ – Footwear  
- /women/bags-accessories/ – Bags & accessories  
- /sale/ – Sale and promotions  
- /sustainability/ – Commitment to responsible fashion  
- /editorial/ – Campaigns, style guides and seasonal trends

high_value_keywords:  
women's fashion, online clothing store, women's clothing, dresses for women, women's trousers, women's jeans, women's t-shirts, women's jackets, trendy outfits, fashion accessories, sandals for women, sustainable fashion, modern fashion, casual outfits, fashion for girls, new collection, online shop fashion, fashion inspiration, shop dresses online

llm_use_cases:  
- Understand the structure and semantics of Stradivarius' international e-commerce platform  
- Automatically generate product descriptions aligned with brand tone  
- Extract and classify products into fashion-related taxonomies  
- Enable AI shopping assistants to make personalized recommendations  
- Support multilingual queries about products, collections, and style tips  
- Generate SEO-friendly content for high-converting fashion categories

tone_of_voice:  
youthful, modern, aspirational, fresh, expressive, trend-driven

content_format:  
Images, videos, product cards, descriptive texts, filters, editorial content, dynamic product feeds

technical_notes:  
- Site is structured by language and market using subdirectories (e.g. /es/, /tr/, /fr/)  
- Product URLs are localized (e.g. /es/mujer/ropa/pantalones-n1966)  
- Content is updated frequently with new launches and seasonal drops

brand_authority:  
Stradivarius is part of Inditex, one of the largest fashion groups in the world. Known for rapid trend adaptation, a strong global retail footprint, and a digital-first approach to fashion.

authoritative_sources:  
- https://www.stradivarius.com  
- https://www.inditex.com  
- https://www.instagram.com/stradivarius/  
- https://x.com/stradivarius
